public.title: Immutable Array
public.description: input {value,operations}; value is an array. Operations are {op:"push",value}, {op:"set",index,value} with valid existing index, or {op:"remove",index} with valid existing index. Return {original,updated}; preserve original and apply edits in sequence, with remove shifting later elements. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.

explanation: Copy then process array edits. With n initial elements and q edits, worst-case O(n plus q times (n plus q)) time due to shifts; space O(input plus added values). Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
